text:
sara: Quick heads up — ACME contract signing tomorrow morning. Need final capacity plan for the committed SKU. Questions I need answered before legal: reserved GPU count, expected burst/autoscale behavior, prewarm time, and any known blockers for AZ failover. Can we get numbers and config snippet to put in the SOW? :pray:

devin: Early modeling done — workload: 5k text-gen RPS equivalent with median seq ~256, 99p latency target ~250ms. For that profile we estimate ~8 reserved p4-equivalent GPUs for steady-state. Autoscale pool to add +4 GPUs for bursts (so max 12). Recommend committing to 8 reserved and allowing burst pool for 30% traffic spikes. :thumbsup:

linh: Couple notes — runtime density depends a lot on batch size and streaming. If ACME uses streaming responses per-token, throughput per-GPU drops ~30%. Autoscale defaults: cooldown 10m, node prewarm (model load) ~4 minutes per node. Suggest config: keep min=8, max=12, cooldown=600s, prewarm_count=2 so two nodes are always ready. Also enable AZ affinity to keep reserved capacity evenly spread for failover.

rafi: Add-on: KV cache and prefix warmup matter for first-minute latency. If they pin a model version we can pre-populate frequent prefixes (we did this for another client) which cuts cold-client latency for the first 100–200k tokens. Also enable continuous batching with a 50ms collection window to improve GPU utilization without blowing P99.

tom: From a pricing/SOW perspective: if we call out "8 reserved + 4 burst" we need a blended committed monthly spend to show legal. Can engineering give a ballpark monthly rate so I can put in the draft SOW? They asked for a number this afternoon.

devin: Ballpark for proposal only: ≈$Xk/mo for 8 reserved p4-equivalent units, with burst pool billed on usage. I'll sync with pricing to convert to exact dollars, but you can use the placeholder in the SOW and mark as estimate.

linh: Config snippet you can paste into the SOW/ops-runbook:
```json
{"autoscale":{"min":8,"max":12,"cooldown_sec":600,"prewarm_count":2,"az_affinity":true},"prewarm":"model-load","batching_ms":50}
```

sara: Great — I'll add those numbers (with estimate flag) and the config snippet. @linh please include a short note about AZ fallback test and 1-hour surge runway for the first week after launch. Also need a one-paragraph note about security: will send the security questionnaire to support.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Reserved pool provisioning ETA: ~3 hours after contract activation (provisioning depends on quotas).

rafi: Follow-up: if they want lower cost, we can propose quantized model variant on dedicated nodes — tradeoff: ~10–15% quality delta for ~30–40% cost savings. Mentioned it to the customer as optional.

tom: I'll draft the SOW with these placeholders and route to pricing/legal. Thanks team — can we do a 30-min hangout in 30m if anyone is free to finalize wording? :calendar:
